correctness.rationale: An independent exact computation from the eight displayed vectors grouped point-pairs by their joining lines, with a common-denominator quadratic-integer normalization. It obtained 28 distinct seed points and 33 rich joins, all integral after first-nonzero-coordinate normalization. The six-term determinant expansion over all 5456 triples gave 480 zeros and the listed norm support. In increasing norm order 1,2,4,8,14,16,28,32,36,56,64,72 the frequencies were 373,504,1165,1346,32,800,128,364,32,112,88,32. The original rank is three and every distinct pair extends to an independent triple; outside 2,3,7 its determinant cannot vanish by the norm identity, so both line distinctness and the triple-incidence relation persist. These determine the intersection lattice. Pair-cross-product counts over the quadratic field, F9, and both split evaluations in F7 gave exactly the three stated histograms and 33 distinct lines in each special fiber. The other root in characteristic 3 is conjugate by Frobenius, which preserves the census. Each pair intersection over the field of definition remains a single geometric point over its closure.
